subject: Buy flow stuck — what finance needs from us
messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@northstaranalytics.com>, Mike Reilly <mike.reilly@northstaranalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-28T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Recap: Discovery — procurement & billing next steps

Thanks again for your time today — helpful discussion. Quick recap and a few asks so we can unblock procurement: 

What we heard from you:
- Preferred commercial path: procurement-led (purchase order) if possible; might consider marketplace if it simplifies procurement.
- Finance needs vendor paperwork (W9 + vendor setup form) and SOC2 summary for security review.
- Contract: they want to review standard SOW and sample invoice.

Action items I promised: 
1) Attach draft quote + SOW for their review (attached).
2) Confirm payment terms and PO workflow from our side.
3) Share SOC2 summary and where to find audit artifacts.

Attachments: Redwood_Quote_NS-4789.pdf, Scope_of_Work_NS-4789.docx

Can you confirm whether your finance team requires a specific vendor setup form or a named vendor packet? Also, if you could indicate whether you prefer Redwood to bill against a PO or via company card for the initial pilot, that will help us route the right next steps internally.

I'll loop in Marissa (sales ops) and Lauren (marketplace) for any marketplace questions.

Thanks —
Dev Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

From: Mike Reilly <mike.reilly@northstaranalytics.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Ellen Park <ellen.park@northstaranalytics.com>
Date: 2027-03-29T09:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: Discovery — procurement & billing next steps

Thanks Dev — good summary. A couple clarifications from procurement: 

- Finance will need W9 + vendor name and EIN to set up a supplier record. Can you provide the legal entity name and EIN?
- They asked for a sample invoice format (PDF) showing line items and a billing address.
- Preferred approach: purchase order (PO) for the contract value. But we are open to marketplace if Redwood offers a Marketplace SKU that bills to us directly — that could speed things up if your marketplace supports our internal approval flows.

Also: what payment terms do you normally accept for PO customers (Net 30/Net 45)?

We have a procurement review meeting scheduled Friday 2027-04-01 at 10:00am PT — would be helpful to have the SOC2 summary and sample invoice before then.

Thanks,
Mike Reilly
Procurement Manager | NorthStar Analytics
mike.reilly@northstaranalytics.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-03-29T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Recap: Discovery — procurement & billing next steps

Looping Lauren for marketplace / listing questions. Quick answers to Mike's questions: 

- Legal entity / EIN: Redwood Inference, Inc. — EIN: 12-3456789. (I'll attach a W9 export in the next message.)
- Sample invoice: we generate line-itemized PDFs; see attached example (I will upload to the thread).
- Payment terms for PO customers: Net 30 by default; Net 45 negotiable for enterprise with approval.
- Marketplace: we can support Google Cloud Marketplace and AWS Marketplace — Lauren can confirm timing and whether a marketplace SKU is active for NS-4789. Marketplace purchases typically require a different ordering flow and may have a listing-specific contract.

Next steps for us: 
- Dev: send W9 + SOC2 summary + sample invoice before their procurement meeting.
- Lauren: advise whether marketplace SKU is live and any additional docs required.

Marissa Cole
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@northstaranalytics.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Mike Reilly <mike.reilly@northstaranalytics.com>
Date: 2027-03-30T14:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: Discovery — procurement & billing next steps

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Couple of items from Security & Legal that will be raised in the procurement meeting: 

- We need a SOC2 attestation summary (high level is fine) and a contact for security questions.
- Data handling / retention policy — do you have a public or customer-facing policy we can attach to the vendor packet?
- Contract: procurement would like to see the SOW and a statement of work that references data residency and breach notification timelines.

I can share a vendor packet template if that helps — but ideally we'd prefer the documents on your side pre-populated: vendor name, EIN, W9, SOC2 summary, sample invoice, and SOW.

If you can get these into the thread before Friday 10am PT, the procurement meeting can likely sign off and we can issue a PO.

Thanks,
Ellen Park
Director, Finance & Procurement | NorthStar Analytics
ellen.park@northstaranalytics.com
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@northstaranalytics.com>, Mike Reilly <mike.reilly@northstaranalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-01T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: Discovery — procurement & billing next steps

Ellen / Mike — thanks, attaching the requested items and confirming next steps before your Friday meeting: 

Attachments included: 
- Redwood_Quote_NS-4789.pdf (detailed line items & sample invoice page included)
- Scope_of_Work_NS-4789.docx (SOW with data residency and breach notification section)
- SOC2_Audit_Summary.pdf (high-level attestation + contact for security questions)

Key confirmations: 
- Legal entity / EIN: Redwood Inference, Inc. — EIN: 12-3456789.
- Payment terms: PO / Net 30 by default; we can accept Net 45 with approval.
- Marketplace: Lauren is on copy — she confirms we can offer a marketplace order but that requires a separate listing and purchasing flow which may not be faster than issuing a PO for the pilot.

Links: DocuSign contract (if you want to accelerate signature): https://www.docusign.com/00A1B2C3-NS-4789
Redwood vendor packet & invoice template: https://app.redwood.ai/docs/vendors/NS-4789-quote

If procurement issues the PO after your meeting, please include billing@redwood.ai as the invoice recipient and copy accounts@redwood.ai so our AR team associates it with the right deal.

Happy to hop on a 15-minute call after your meeting if anything comes up.

Best,
Dev Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

(attachments: Redwood_Quote_NS-4789.pdf, Scope_of_Work_NS-4789.docx, SOC2_Audit_Summary.pdf)
